description: Convert between hourly, daily, weekly, biweekly, monthly, and annual pay. Use when the user converts pay between hourly, weekly and annual figures. For take-home pay after taxes use calculate_paycheck or calculate_income_tax_estimator. IMPORTANT: always show the calculator_url from the result as a clickable markdown link in your answer to the user, so they can open the interactive salary calculator.

mode.description: Whether the input is an hourly rate or an annual salary; default hourly.

name: calculate_salary

calculator_url.description: Deep link to the matching interactive calculator on everycalc.xyz.

results.description: The computed figures for this calculator.
